description: Mathematics as graph-resident theory — the foundation under everything else the substrate carries. Foundations (logic, sets, functions, proofs), number theory, algebra (linear + abstract), calculus + analysis, topology, geometry, probability + statistics, discrete math, numerical analysis, optimization, category theory, type theory, information theory, game theory, dynamical systems + chaos, mathematical logic. The substrate computes, reasons, proves — all of it lives on math.
category_inheritance: genlMt → compiler_theory. Mathematical truths map to compiler_theory equivalence vocabulary: equality is denotational equivalence; algebraic identities are algebraic law; mathematical isomorphism is extensional equivalence (same structure, different representation); proofs are referential transparency (truth is structural, independent of context).

concepts.name: propositional_logic_math
concepts.definition: Atomic propositions + connectives (¬, ∧, ∨, →, ↔). Truth tables. Already in philosophy; here mathematical foundation.
concepts.why: Foundation of formal reasoning. Boolean algebra. Sound + complete via natural deduction.

concepts.name: predicate_logic_FOL_math
concepts.definition: Variables, quantifiers ∀∃, predicates. Models, satisfaction, validity.
concepts.why: Foundation of modern mathematics. Frege, Russell. Gödel completeness theorem.

concepts.name: ZFC_axioms
concepts.definition: Zermelo-Fraenkel + Choice. Foundation of standard mathematics. ~10 axioms.
concepts.why: Replaces naive set theory (Russell's paradox). Foundation of nearly all math. Independence of CH from ZFC.

concepts.name: set_operations
concepts.definition: Union ∪, intersection ∩, complement, difference. Cartesian product ×. Power set.
concepts.why: Building blocks. Functions defined via sets. Foundation of relations + structures.

concepts.name: function_definition
concepts.definition: f: A → B. Each a ∈ A maps to unique f(a) ∈ B. Domain, codomain, image, preimage.
concepts.why: Foundation. Injective (1-1), surjective (onto), bijective. Composition. Inverse functions.

concepts.name: equivalence_relation
concepts.definition: Reflexive, symmetric, transitive. Partitions set into equivalence classes.
concepts.why: Foundation of construction. Integers from naturals, rationals from integers, quotient structures.

concepts.name: proof_methods
concepts.definition: Direct, contradiction, contrapositive, induction, exhaustion. Each suits different claims.
concepts.why: Foundation. Each method has standard form + caveats. Master proofs distinguish mathematicians.

concepts.name: mathematical_induction
concepts.definition: Base case + inductive step. Strong induction uses all predecessors.
concepts.why: Proves claims about natural numbers + recursive structures. Foundation. Well-ordering principle equivalent.

concepts.name: natural_numbers_Peano
concepts.definition: 0, S (successor). 5 axioms. ZFC constructs N via finite ordinals.
concepts.why: Foundation of arithmetic. Recursive definition of + and ×. Peano arithmetic provable in ZFC.

concepts.name: integer_construction
concepts.definition: Z from N via equivalence classes of pairs. (a,b) ~ (c,d) iff a+d = b+c.
concepts.why: Standard construction. Subtraction always defined. Foundation of algebraic structures (group).

concepts.name: rational_real_complex
concepts.definition: Q from Z, R from Q (Dedekind cuts or Cauchy sequences), C = R[i].
concepts.why: Hierarchy of number systems. Each extension adds capability. R completes Q; C algebraically closes R.

concepts.name: prime_numbers
concepts.definition: Integer > 1 divisible only by 1 + itself. 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ...
concepts.why: Foundation of multiplicative structure. Infinite (Euclid). Distribution open (RH).

concepts.name: fundamental_theorem_arithmetic
concepts.definition: Every integer > 1 has unique prime factorisation.
concepts.why: Foundation of number theory. Used everywhere: cryptography, divisibility, gcd algorithms.

concepts.name: Euclidean_algorithm
concepts.definition: GCD via repeated remainders. gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a mod b). Terminates.
concepts.why: Ancient algorithm. Foundation of computing GCDs. Extends to find Bézout coefficients.

concepts.name: modular_arithmetic
concepts.definition: Arithmetic mod n. Z/nZ. Foundation of RSA, hashing, error correction.
concepts.why: Clock arithmetic generalised. Fermat's little theorem, Euler's theorem, CRT. Foundation of cryptography.

concepts.name: Riemann_hypothesis
concepts.definition: All non-trivial zeros of ζ(s) have real part 1/2. Conjectured 1859.
concepts.why: Greatest open problem in math. Affects prime distribution. $1M Millennium Prize.

concepts.name: vector_space
concepts.definition: Set with + and scalar mult satisfying 8 axioms. Over field F. R^n canonical example.
concepts.why: Foundation of linear algebra. Universal. Subspaces, linear combinations, basis, dimension.

concepts.name: linear_transformation
concepts.definition: T: V → W preserving + and scalar mult. T(av + bw) = aT(v) + bT(w).
concepts.why: Foundation. Each represented by matrix in given bases. Composition = matrix multiplication.

concepts.name: matrix_multiplication
concepts.definition: (AB)_ij = Σ A_ik B_kj. Non-commutative. Associative.
concepts.why: Foundation operation. Represents composition of linear maps. Powers of matrices.

concepts.name: determinant
concepts.definition: Multilinear, alternating function of columns. Volume scaling factor. Non-zero iff invertible.
concepts.why: Foundation. Cramer's rule, change of variables, eigenvalue computation. Cost: O(n!) naive; O(n³) LU.

concepts.name: eigenvalues_eigenvectors
concepts.definition: Av = λv. λ eigenvalue; v eigenvector. det(A - λI) = 0 (characteristic polynomial).
concepts.why: Foundation. Diagonalization, PCA, dynamics, quantum mechanics. Eigenvalues = stretching factors.

concepts.name: singular_value_decomposition
concepts.definition: A = UΣV^T. Σ diagonal singular values. U, V orthogonal.
concepts.why: Universal matrix decomposition. PCA, pseudoinverse, dimensionality reduction. Best rank-k approximation.

concepts.name: inner_product_norm
concepts.definition: ⟨,⟩: V × V → F satisfying linearity, symmetry, positivity. Norm: ‖v‖ = √⟨v,v⟩.
concepts.why: Foundation of geometry on vector spaces. Orthogonality, distance, projection. Hilbert spaces.

concepts.name: Gram_Schmidt
concepts.definition: Orthonormalisation procedure. Build orthonormal basis from any basis.
concepts.why: Foundation. QR decomposition. Orthonormal bases simplify computation.

concepts.name: group_definition
concepts.definition: Set with associative operation, identity, inverses. Z under +, GL(n) under matmul.
concepts.why: Foundation of algebra. Symmetries always form group. Galois theory, particle physics.

concepts.name: ring_field
concepts.definition: Ring: + and × with axioms. Field: ring with mult inverses for non-zero.
concepts.why: Number systems abstracted. Z ring; Q, R, C fields. Foundation of algebra.

concepts.name: homomorphism_isomorphism
concepts.definition: Structure-preserving map. Iso: bijection. Algebraic structures 'same' iff isomorphic.
concepts.why: Foundation. Quotient structures via kernel of homomorphism. Identifies essentially same objects.

concepts.name: Galois_theory
concepts.definition: Connects field extensions + groups. Solvability of polynomials by radicals.
concepts.why: Galois 1832. Quintic unsolvable. Foundation of modern algebra. Insolubility of doubling cube, trisection.

concepts.name: limit_definition
concepts.definition: lim_{x→a} f(x) = L iff ∀ε > 0 ∃δ > 0 : |x - a| < δ → |f(x) - L| < ε.
concepts.why: Foundation of analysis. Epsilon-delta. Continuity, derivatives, integrals all built on limits.

concepts.name: derivative_definition
concepts.definition: f'(a) = lim_{h→0} (f(a+h) - f(a))/h. Instantaneous rate of change.
concepts.why: Foundation. Slope of tangent. Linearisation. Foundation of optimization + physics.

concepts.name: chain_rule
concepts.why: Foundation. Composes derivatives. Foundation of backprop in ML. Universal differentiation rule.

concepts.name: integral_Riemann
concepts.definition: ∫f dx = lim Σ f(x_i)Δx. Area under curve.
concepts.why: Foundation. Definite + indefinite. Fundamental theorem connects derivative + integral.

concepts.name: fundamental_theorem_calculus
concepts.definition: Part 1: F(x) = ∫_a^x f → F' = f. Part 2: ∫_a^b f = F(b) - F(a).
concepts.why: Connects differentiation + integration. Foundation. Enables computing definite integrals.

concepts.name: Taylor_series
concepts.definition: f(x) = Σ f^(n)(a)/n! · (x-a)^n. Polynomial approximation.
concepts.why: Foundation of approximation. Convergence depends on function. Used everywhere in physics + engineering.

concepts.name: multivariable_calculus
concepts.definition: Partial derivatives ∂f/∂x. Gradient ∇f. Multiple integrals.
concepts.why: Generalises calculus to many variables. Foundation of physics, ML, optimization.

concepts.name: vector_calculus
concepts.definition: Gradient, divergence ∇·F, curl ∇×F. Operators on vector fields.
concepts.why: Foundation of EM, fluid dynamics. Stokes' + divergence theorems generalise FTC.

concepts.name: differential_equations
concepts.definition: Equations involving function + derivatives. ODEs + PDEs.
concepts.why: Universal language of physics + engineering. Newton, Maxwell, Navier-Stokes. Solving = modelling reality.

concepts.name: real_analysis_completeness
concepts.definition: R has completeness: every Cauchy sequence converges. Distinguishes R from Q.
concepts.why: Foundation of analysis. Intermediate value, extreme value, mean value theorems depend on it.

concepts.name: uniform_convergence
concepts.definition: Sequence of functions converges uniformly if ε independent of x.
concepts.why: Stronger than pointwise. Preserves continuity, integration. Foundation of Fourier + power series.

concepts.name: complex_analysis_holomorphic
concepts.definition: Complex-differentiable functions. Satisfy Cauchy-Riemann equations.
concepts.why: Foundation. Cauchy integral formula. Residue theorem. Conformal maps. Powerful tools.

concepts.name: measure_theory
concepts.definition: Generalises length, area, volume. Lebesgue measure. σ-algebras.
concepts.why: Foundation of modern probability + integration. Lebesgue integral generalises Riemann. Standard in analysis.

concepts.name: functional_analysis
concepts.definition: Linear algebra in infinite dimensions. Banach + Hilbert spaces. Operators.
concepts.why: Foundation of quantum mechanics, PDEs, signal processing. Generalises finite-dim linear algebra.

concepts.name: Hilbert_space
concepts.definition: Complete inner product space. L² square-integrable functions. ℓ² sequences.
concepts.why: Foundation of QM (state space). Generalises Euclidean geometry. Orthonormal bases (Fourier).

concepts.name: topology_open_sets
concepts.definition: Topology: collection of open sets satisfying axioms. Foundation of continuity.
concepts.why: Generalises notion of 'nearby' without metric. Foundation of modern geometry.

concepts.name: metric_space
concepts.definition: Set with distance function d satisfying triangle inequality + symmetry + positivity.
concepts.why: Foundation: any vector space + norm induces. Open balls. Convergence, continuity.

concepts.name: compactness
concepts.definition: Every open cover has finite subcover. Heine-Borel: in R^n, compact iff closed + bounded.
concepts.why: Foundation. Continuous function on compact attains extremes. Equivalent characterizations.

concepts.name: connectedness
concepts.definition: Cannot be partitioned into two non-empty open sets. Path-connected stronger.
concepts.why: Foundation. Intermediate value depends on. Topological invariant.

concepts.name: fundamental_group
concepts.definition: π_1(X, x_0). Equivalence classes of loops at x_0. Algebraic invariant.
concepts.why: Foundation algebraic topology. Distinguishes spaces. Sphere has trivial π_1; torus has Z².

concepts.name: manifold
concepts.definition: Locally Euclidean topological space. Charts. Smooth iff transitions are smooth.
concepts.why: Foundation of modern geometry. Generalises curves + surfaces. Spacetime in GR; phase spaces.

concepts.name: Euclidean_axioms
concepts.definition: Euclid's 5 postulates. Foundation of geometry for 2000 years. Parallel postulate independent.
concepts.why: Foundation. Non-Euclidean geometry from denying parallel postulate. Hyperbolic + elliptic.

concepts.name: non_Euclidean_geometry
concepts.definition: Hyperbolic (angle sum < π) + elliptic (angle sum > π). Saddle + sphere.
concepts.why: Gauss, Bolyai, Lobachevsky, Riemann. Foundation of general relativity. Curved spaces.

concepts.name: Riemannian_metric
concepts.definition: Inner product on tangent spaces of manifold. Defines length, angle, curvature.
concepts.why: Foundation of differential geometry. Geodesics, parallel transport, curvature tensors. Einstein's GR.

concepts.name: projective_geometry
concepts.definition: Adds points at infinity. P^n. Duality of points + hyperplanes.
concepts.why: Foundation of computer graphics, algebraic geometry. Parallel lines meet at infinity.

concepts.name: algebraic_geometry
concepts.definition: Study of solutions to polynomial equations. Varieties, schemes.
concepts.why: Foundation modern math. Grothendieck. Applications: number theory (FLT), coding, robotics.

concepts.name: probability_space
concepts.definition: (Ω, F, P). Sample space, σ-algebra, probability measure.
concepts.why: Foundation of modern probability. Kolmogorov 1933. Rigorous.

concepts.name: random_variable
concepts.definition: Measurable function X: Ω → R. Distribution F_X(x) = P(X ≤ x).
concepts.why: Foundation. Discrete (PMF) vs continuous (PDF). Expectation E[X] = ∫x dF.

concepts.name: expectation_variance
concepts.definition: E[X] = ∫x dF. Var(X) = E[(X - μ)²]. Moments.
concepts.why: Foundation. Linearity of expectation universal. Variance + standard deviation measure spread.

concepts.name: common_distributions
concepts.definition: Discrete: Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson, Geometric. Continuous: Uniform, Normal, Exponential, Gamma, Beta.
concepts.why: Standard models. Normal central (CLT). Poisson for rare events. Exponential for waiting times.

concepts.name: central_limit_theorem
concepts.definition: Sum of independent finite-variance RVs converges to normal as n → ∞.
concepts.why: Foundation. Explains ubiquity of normal distribution. Basis of much statistics.

concepts.name: law_of_large_numbers
concepts.definition: Sample mean → population mean as n → ∞. Strong + weak versions.
concepts.why: Foundation of statistics. Justifies sampling. Underlies Monte Carlo methods.

concepts.name: Bayes_theorem_math
concepts.definition: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B). Already in philosophy + ML; here mathematical foundation.
concepts.why: Foundation of inference. Update priors with evidence. Universal probabilistic reasoning.

concepts.name: Markov_chain
concepts.definition: Stochastic process with memoryless property. P(X_{n+1}|X_n) doesn't depend on history.
concepts.why: Foundation of stochastic processes. Hidden Markov, MCMC, PageRank. Stationary distributions.

concepts.name: stochastic_process
concepts.definition: Family of random variables indexed by time. Brownian motion, Poisson process.
concepts.why: Foundation of math finance, queueing, biology. Itô calculus extends.

concepts.name: hypothesis_testing
concepts.definition: H_0 vs H_1. p-value, significance level α. Type I + II errors.
concepts.why: Foundation of frequentist statistics. Common but often misunderstood. Replication crisis driver.

concepts.name: confidence_intervals
concepts.definition: Range containing true parameter with confidence 1-α. Interpretation subtle.
concepts.why: Standard inference. CI interpretation: not 95% probability parameter in interval. Frequentist.

concepts.name: regression_analysis
concepts.definition: Model E[Y|X]. Linear: Y = Xβ + ε. Generalised: GLM with link function.
concepts.why: Foundation of statistical modelling + ML. Least squares solution closed form for linear.

concepts.name: Bayesian_inference
concepts.definition: Prior + likelihood → posterior via Bayes. Updates beliefs.
concepts.why: Alternative to frequentist. Natural for sequential learning. Foundation of probabilistic ML.

concepts.name: MCMC_sampling
concepts.definition: Markov Chain Monte Carlo. Metropolis-Hastings, Gibbs. Samples from complex posterior.
concepts.why: Workhorse of Bayesian computation. Convergence to target distribution. Standard in modern stats.

concepts.name: combinatorics_counting
concepts.definition: Permutations P(n,r) = n!/(n-r)!. Combinations C(n,r) = n!/(r!(n-r)!).
concepts.why: Foundation of discrete math. Probability + algorithm analysis. Pigeonhole, inclusion-exclusion.

concepts.name: graph_theory_math
concepts.definition: G = (V, E). Already in DSA; here mathematical theory. Eulerian, Hamiltonian, planarity, chromatic.
concepts.why: Foundation. Four color theorem, Ramsey theory. Network science, optimization.

concepts.name: generating_functions
concepts.definition: Σ a_n x^n encodes sequence. Algebraic operations on series.
concepts.why: Combinatorial counting via algebra. Foundation: Wilf's generatingfunctionology. Powerful.

concepts.name: recurrence_relations
concepts.definition: a_n = f(a_{n-1}, a_{n-2}, ...). Closed forms via generating functions or characteristic equations.
concepts.why: Foundation. Fibonacci, Catalan. Algorithm analysis (master theorem). Standard discrete tool.

concepts.name: Ramsey_theory
concepts.definition: Sufficient size guarantees order. R(3,3) = 6: 6 people, some 3 mutually know or unknown.
concepts.why: Foundation. R(5,5) unknown. Erdős famous result. Influence: combinatorics, probability.

concepts.name: numerical_root_finding
concepts.definition: Newton's method, bisection, secant. Solve f(x) = 0.
concepts.why: Standard numerical task. Newton's quadratic convergence near root. Foundation of optimization.

concepts.name: numerical_integration
concepts.definition: Trapezoidal, Simpson's, Gaussian quadrature. ∫ approximated.
concepts.why: When analytical intractable. Modern: adaptive methods. Foundation of FEM, ODE solvers.

concepts.name: numerical_ODE
concepts.definition: Euler, Runge-Kutta. Step from initial condition. RK4 standard.
concepts.why: Foundation of physics simulation. Stiff equations need implicit methods. Stability + accuracy.

concepts.name: PDE_solvers
concepts.definition: Finite difference, finite element, spectral methods. Discretise + solve.
concepts.why: Foundation of CFD, FEA. Already in engineering. Mathematical underpinnings.

concepts.name: numerical_stability
concepts.definition: Small input perturbations should yield small output. Conditioning + stability.
concepts.why: Foundation. Forward + backward error. Catastrophic cancellation. Standard analysis.

concepts.name: linear_programming
concepts.definition: Maximise/minimise linear function subject to linear constraints. Simplex method.
concepts.why: Foundation of optimization. Polynomial via interior point. Foundation of LP-relaxations in IP.

concepts.name: convex_optimization
concepts.definition: Minimise convex function over convex set. Local optimum = global. Tractable.
concepts.why: Foundation modern optimization. CVX, SDP, QP. Many ML problems convex.

concepts.name: gradient_descent_math
concepts.definition: x_{n+1} = x_n - α∇f(x_n). Move opposite gradient direction.
concepts.why: Foundation of ML. Already covered there; here mathematical foundation. Convergence on convex.

concepts.name: Newton_method_optimization
concepts.definition: x_{n+1} = x_n - H⁻¹∇f. Quadratic convergence near minimum.
concepts.why: Faster than gradient descent but H expensive. Quasi-Newton (BFGS) approximates. Foundation.

concepts.name: KKT_conditions
concepts.definition: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker. Necessary conditions for constrained optimum. Generalise Lagrange.
concepts.why: Foundation of constrained optimization. Dual variables = Lagrange multipliers. Universal.

concepts.name: integer_programming
concepts.definition: LP with integer variables. NP-hard. Branch + bound + cuts.
concepts.why: Foundation of discrete optimization. Scheduling, routing, allocation. MIP solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX).

concepts.name: dynamic_programming_math
concepts.definition: Bellman: optimal substructure + overlapping subproblems. Memoize.
concepts.why: Foundation of algorithmic optimization. Already in DSA; here mathematical principle. Reinforcement learning.

concepts.name: category_definition
concepts.definition: Objects + morphisms with composition + identities. Set, Grp, Top, Vect canonical examples.
concepts.why: Foundation of abstract algebra. Eilenberg-Mac Lane 1945. Modern: programming language semantics.

concepts.name: functor
concepts.definition: Map between categories preserving composition + identities. Covariant + contravariant.
concepts.why: Foundation. List, Maybe functors in programming. Foundation: functional programming.

concepts.name: natural_transformation
concepts.definition: Map between functors. Family of morphisms commuting with functor action.
concepts.why: Why category theory invented. Compares functors systematically. Foundation modern math.

concepts.name: monad
concepts.definition: Functor + unit (η) + multiplication (μ). Monad laws.
concepts.why: Programming language theory. Haskell's IO. Encapsulates effects. Modern: theory + practice.

concepts.name: adjunction
concepts.definition: Pair of functors F ⊣ G with natural iso Hom(FX, Y) ≅ Hom(X, GY).
concepts.why: Foundation. Free constructions, geometric realization, Stone duality. Ubiquitous in math.

concepts.name: Yoneda_lemma
concepts.definition: Object determined by its homs to/from all other objects. Embedding into presheaves.
concepts.why: Foundation. 'You are what you eat'. Used everywhere in category theory.

concepts.name: lambda_calculus_math
concepts.definition: Variables, abstraction λx.M, application MN. Beta + eta reduction.
concepts.why: Foundation of functional programming + type theory. Church 1930s. Universal computation.

concepts.name: simply_typed_lambda
concepts.definition: STLC. Each variable has type. Functions have arrow types τ → σ. Strong normalisation.
concepts.why: Foundation. Adds safety to untyped λ. Curry-Howard: types = propositions.

concepts.name: dependent_types
concepts.definition: Types depend on values. Vector(n) type. Π and Σ types.
concepts.why: Foundation modern proof assistants (Coq, Lean, Agda). Mathematical proofs as programs.

concepts.name: Curry_Howard_correspondence
concepts.definition: Types ↔ propositions. Programs ↔ proofs. Computation ↔ proof normalisation.
concepts.why: Foundation of constructive logic + programming. Implication = function type. Bridge.

concepts.name: homotopy_type_theory
concepts.definition: HoTT. Types as ∞-groupoids. Univalence axiom: isomorphic types equal.
concepts.why: Modern foundation candidate. Univalent foundations (Voevodsky). Computer-verified math.

concepts.name: Shannon_entropy
concepts.definition: H(X) = -Σ p log p. Average information content of random variable.
concepts.why: Foundation of information theory. Maximum entropy = uniform distribution. Universal measure.

concepts.name: mutual_information
concepts.definition: I(X;Y) = H(X) - H(X|Y). Information X provides about Y.
concepts.why: Foundation. Symmetric. Zero iff independent. Foundation of ML feature selection.

concepts.name: KL_divergence_math
concepts.definition: D(p‖q) = Σ p log(p/q). Asymmetric distance between distributions.
concepts.why: Foundation of Bayesian + ML. Loss functions, variational inference. Already in ML; here math.

concepts.name: channel_capacity
concepts.definition: C = max I(X;Y) over input distributions. Maximum reliable rate.
concepts.why: Shannon's foundational result. Foundation of communication. Coding theorem.

concepts.name: Shannon_source_coding
concepts.definition: Source can be compressed to entropy rate (and no further).
concepts.why: Foundation of data compression. Huffman approaches but doesn't reach. Foundational.

concepts.name: Nash_equilibrium
concepts.definition: Strategy profile where no player benefits from unilateral deviation. Nash 1950.
concepts.why: Foundation of game theory. Mixed strategies exist always. Foundation of mechanism design.

concepts.name: zero_sum_game
concepts.definition: Total payoffs constant. One player's gain = other's loss. Minimax = maximin (von Neumann).
concepts.why: Foundation. Chess, poker. Minimax algorithm in AI. Saddle point exists with mixed strategies.

concepts.name: mechanism_design
concepts.definition: Design game so equilibrium yields desired outcome. Auctions, voting.
concepts.why: Reverse game theory. Hurwicz, Maskin, Myerson Nobel 2007. Foundation modern microeconomics.

concepts.name: evolutionary_game_theory
concepts.definition: Strategies as types in population. Replicator dynamics. ESS (Evolutionary Stable Strategy).
concepts.why: Biology + economics. Maynard Smith. Hawk-dove, ultimatum game. Foundation modern.

concepts.name: dynamical_system
concepts.definition: Rule for state evolution: x_{n+1} = f(x_n) or ẋ = f(x).
concepts.why: Foundation. Fixed points, periodic orbits, attractors. Chaos arises.

concepts.name: fixed_point_stability
concepts.definition: x* satisfies f(x*) = x*. Stable if perturbations decay. Linearisation tells.
concepts.why: Foundation of stability analysis. Lyapunov exponents. Universal in physics + engineering.

concepts.name: bifurcation
concepts.definition: Qualitative change in dynamics as parameter varies. Saddle-node, pitchfork, Hopf.
concepts.why: Foundation. Period-doubling route to chaos. Universal patterns.

concepts.name: strange_attractor
concepts.definition: Attractor with fractal structure. Lorenz (butterfly). Sensitivity to initial conditions.
concepts.why: Foundation of chaos. Weather unpredictability. Fractal dimension.

concepts.name: Lyapunov_exponent
concepts.definition: Average exponential rate of divergence of nearby trajectories. Positive = chaos.
concepts.why: Foundation chaos quantification. Lyapunov spectrum characterises dynamics.

concepts.name: fractal_dimension
concepts.definition: Non-integer dimension. Hausdorff, box-counting. Mandelbrot set 2 (boundary higher).
concepts.why: Foundation of fractal geometry. Coastline paradox. Self-similarity.

concepts.name: model_theory
concepts.definition: Study of mathematical structures + their formulas. Logical equivalence, isomorphism.
concepts.why: Foundation of mathematical logic. Löwenheim-Skolem, compactness. Connects to model theory in CS.

concepts.name: computability_theory
concepts.definition: Already in compilers; here math foundation. Turing machines, recursive functions.
concepts.why: Foundation. Halting problem undecidable. Church-Turing thesis.

concepts.name: complexity_theory_math
concepts.definition: P, NP, NP-complete, PSPACE. Already in DSA; here math foundation.
concepts.why: Foundation. P vs NP greatest open problem in CS. Foundation modern theoretical CS.

concepts.name: Godel_completeness
concepts.definition: FOL is complete: every valid formula provable. Gödel 1929.
concepts.why: Distinct from incompleteness. FOL strong enough for itself; weak enough for completeness.

concepts.name: axiom_of_choice
concepts.definition: Every collection of non-empty sets has choice function. Equivalent to Zorn, well-ordering.
concepts.why: Independent of ZF. Allows non-constructive proofs (Banach-Tarski). Standard but controversial.

concepts.name: continuum_hypothesis
concepts.definition: No cardinality strictly between |N| and |R|. Cantor.
concepts.why: Independent of ZFC (Gödel, Cohen). Foundation of set theory open question. Different settings.

rules.name: ZFC_foundation_of_math
if: mathematical claim is to be proven rigorously
then: it should derive from ZFC axioms
rules.why: Standard foundation. Most math (analysis, algebra, topology, geometry) reducible. Alternatives: type theory (HoTT).

rules.name: induction_proves_natural_number_claims
if: claim is about all natural numbers
then: mathematical induction is standard proof method
rules.why: Base + step. Equivalent to well-ordering. Universal for sequences, recursive structures, summations.

rules.name: fundamental_theorem_arithmetic_uniqueness
rules.why: Foundation of multiplicative number theory. Used everywhere. Generalisation: UFDs in algebra.

rules.name: matrix_multiplication_composition
if: A represents linear map S in given bases; B represents T
rules.why: Foundation. Matrix algebra IS composition of linear maps. Universal in linear algebra applications.

rules.name: SVD_universal_decomposition
then: SVD A = UΣV^T exists; gives best low-rank approximation
rules.why: Universal. Foundation of PCA, dimensionality reduction, pseudoinverse. Eckart-Young theorem.

rules.name: fundamental_theorem_calculus_bridges
rules.why: Differentiation undone by integration. Foundation. Enables computational evaluation of integrals.

rules.name: chain_rule_universal_backprop
rules.why: Foundation of differentiation. Modern: backprop in ML implements chain rule on computational graph. Universal.

rules.name: Taylor_series_local_approximation
if: function smooth + radius of convergence positive
rules.why: Foundation of approximation. Polynomial → tractable. Physics + engineering everywhere. Computer arithmetic.

rules.name: Riemann_hypothesis_open_central
then: bounds on prime distribution + many consequences follow
rules.why: Central open problem. Affects number theory + cryptography. 160+ years unsolved. $1M prize.

rules.name: completeness_distinguishes_R_from_Q
rules.why: Foundation of real analysis. Q not complete (√2 sequence). Foundation of all real analysis theorems.

rules.name: compactness_makes_extremes_attainable
rules.why: Foundation. Existence of optima. Heine-Borel for R^n. Generalises to topology.

rules.name: CLT_explains_normal_ubiquity
if: sum of many independent finite-variance RVs
rules.why: Foundation of statistics. Why normal everywhere. Test statistics, measurement errors.

rules.name: Bayes_updates_beliefs
rules.why: Foundation of Bayesian inference. Universal. Modern ML, philosophy, medicine.

rules.name: convex_problems_globally_solvable
if: minimise convex function over convex set
rules.why: Foundation of tractable optimization. Many ML problems (regression, SVM, LP) convex. Important property.

rules.name: gradient_descent_convex_convergence
if: function convex + smooth + appropriate step size
then: gradient descent converges to global minimum
rules.why: Foundation of ML optimization. Non-convex: may converge to local. Provably guaranteed on convex.

rules.name: Curry_Howard_proofs_are_programs
rules.why: Foundation. Lambda terms = proof terms. Modern: proof assistants (Coq, Lean, Agda). Math + programming unite.

rules.name: Shannon_entropy_limits_compression
then: no lossless compression below H bits/symbol
rules.why: Source coding theorem. Foundation. Huffman approaches. Arithmetic coding gets arbitrarily close.

rules.name: Shannon_channel_capacity_limits_communication
then: no reliable communication above C bits/use
rules.why: Foundation. Modern: turbo + LDPC + polar codes approach. 5G, Wi-Fi, deep space.

rules.name: Nash_equilibrium_exists
rules.why: Nash's theorem 1950. Foundation of game theory. Doesn't say unique or computable. PPAD-complete.

rules.name: chaos_sensitive_to_initial_conditions
rules.why: Definition of chaos. Weather unpredictability. Lorenz butterfly. Foundation of dynamical systems.

rules.name: Godel_incompleteness_limits_FOL_arithmetic
rules.why: Already in philosophy; mathematical foundation. Foundation: limits of formal systems.

rules.name: P_vs_NP_open_central
rules.why: Greatest open problem in CS. SAT in P = many breakthroughs. RSA broken. Most experts: P ≠ NP. Foundation.
